1	export type Cell = [number, number];
2	
3	const NEIGHBOR_OFFSETS: Cell[] = [
4	  [-1, -1],
5	  [-1, 0],
6	  [-1, 1],
7	  [0, -1],
8	  [0, 1],
9	  [1, -1],
10	  [1, 0],
11	  [1, 1],
12	];
13	
14	const neighborsOf = ([x, y]: Cell): Cell[] =>
15	  NEIGHBOR_OFFSETS.map(([dx, dy]): Cell => [x + dx, y + dy]);
16	
17	const identityOf = ([x, y]: Cell): string => `${x},${y}`;
18	
19	const contains = (cells: Cell[], cell: Cell): boolean =>
20	  cells.some((other) => identityOf(other) === identityOf(cell));
21	
22	const countLiveNeighbors = (cell: Cell, liveCells: Cell[]): number =>
23	  neighborsOf(cell).filter((neighbor) => contains(liveCells, neighbor)).length;
24	
25	const withoutDuplicates = (cells: Cell[]): Cell[] => [
26	  ...new Map(cells.map((cell) => [identityOf(cell), cell])).values(),
27	];
28	
29	const candidates = (liveCells: Cell[]): Cell[] =>
30	  withoutDuplicates([...liveCells, ...liveCells.flatMap(neighborsOf)]);
31	
32	export const nextGeneration = (liveCells: Cell[]): Cell[] =>
33	  candidates(liveCells).filter(
34	    (cell) => countLiveNeighbors(cell, liveCells) === 3,
35	  );
